# REFRAME Studio

> REFRAME Studio designs refined, multilingual websites and portfolio systems for architecture, interior design, and landscape studios.

REFRAME Studio helps design practices present projects clearly, build trust on desktop and mobile, and create a direct path from discovery to enquiry. The studio serves clients in Spain, Europe, and internationally in Spanish, English, and French.

## Services

- [Website design services](https://reframestudio.es/es/services/): Redesign, portfolio, visibility, hosting, and brand refinement services.
- [Website pricing](https://reframestudio.es/es/pricing/): One-time projects from 790€, plus care plans and add-ons.
- [Website review](https://reframestudio.es/es/audit/): A focused review of UX, mobile, portfolio, SEO, and enquiry flow.

## Portfolio

- [Selected redesign studies](https://reframestudio.es/es/work/): Concept studies for architecture and interior design websites.
- [Villa architecture studio](https://reframestudio.es/es/work/villa-architecture-studio/): Portfolio hierarchy, mobile presentation, and enquiry flow.
- [Casa Noma Marbella](https://reframestudio.es/es/work/casa-noma-marbella/): Interior design storytelling, services, mobile, and CMS structure.
- [Forma Sur Málaga](https://reframestudio.es/es/work/forma-sur-malaga/): Architecture archive, identity, mobile, and CMS structure.
- [Terral Studio Estepona](https://reframestudio.es/es/work/terral-studio-estepona/): Landscape portfolio, services, mobile, and CMS structure.

## Guides

- [SEO for architecture studios](https://reframestudio.es/es/search-visibility/): Search structure, project content, technical SEO, schema, and hreflang.
- [Contact REFRAME Studio](https://reframestudio.es/es/contact/): Send a current website or project idea for a clear next step.
